verdict.rationale: Ente ships an official CLI: the docs point to "Ente's CLI" for automatic Auth backups, and a runtime probe found it packaged in Homebrew as ente-cli 0.3.0. Its documented scope is narrow, covering exporting data and decrypting Auth exports. missing for 10: CLI commands for generating or viewing codes, adding or managing entries, documented command reference or agent-oriented usage, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: You can use [Ente's CLI](https://github.com/ente/ente/tree/main/cli#readme) to automatically backup your Auth codes.
Ente's official CLI is packaged in Homebrew as ente-cli 0.3.0, described by the formula itself as 'Utility for exporting data from Ente and decrypt the export from Ente Auth'
